verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so quantization is a fair axis. The docs mention 2-bit exports, but only on the paid hosted platform (cactus-compute-docs-3). A community benchmark ran a fine-tuned Needle 3 model in W4A8 form, i.e. 4-bit weights with 8-bit activations (cactus-compute-comm-10). That shows some low-bit integer quantization exists, but the evidence never documents a selectable range of bit-widths up to 8-bit or any memory-footprint figures. Missing for 10: documented quantization options covering low-bit through INT8, first-party docs on choosing a precision in the open-source engine or convert tool, memory-reduction figures, independent corroboration of 2-bit exports.
